reference.title: Get help with the Lightwell Network
reference.shortdesc: Access support options and essential resources for the Lightwell Network, including support policies.

ul.li: To report a problem or request assistance, open a support case through the Red Hat customer support.
For the Lightwell Network support policy, see Red Hat Lightwell Support Policy.
To view a Python SBOM, extract the wheel file and navigate to <package>-X.Y.Z.dist-info/sboms/redhat.spdx.json.
To view the Java SBOM, navigate to the directory containing the .jar file and open the cyclonedx.json file.
To view a Python provenance attestation, seepackages.redhat.com/api/pypi/lightwell/<tier>/integrity/<package>/<version>/<wheel_filename>/provenance/.
To view a Java provenance attestation, navigate to the directory with the .jar file and open the .provenance.sigstore.json file.
